mina (runtime): Mini-CI smoke failed for selective-autotune kernel picks on ampere-rt. Not a huge flameout but microbench shows ~12% regression at seqlen=1024. Full run: https://ci.internal/runs/2471234567

sam (perf): saw that. failing test: `kbench/micro/selective_autotune/smoke`. output attached in logs, shows perf delta at p50 and p99.

lena (infra): perf-ci-bot posted an artifact, looks like the autotuner picked an AVX path fallback for matmul when it should've chosen the int8-optimized kernel. cause might be the heuristic weight on "arch_score" vs "seq_len_profile".

perf-ci-bot: nightly-run 2471234567: job=kbench-smoke, status=FAILED, regressions=[{"kernel":"matmul_int8_fast","seqlen":"1024","delta":"-12%"}] (artifact: s3://perf-ci/2471234567/artifacts)

ryan (eng): copying important bits here — command we run in harness:```bash
./kbench --suite selective_autotune --target ampere-rt --seqlens 16,64,256,1024 --runs 50 --compare baseline.json
```

mina (runtime): link to the diff heatmap: https://perf-ui.internal/diff/2471234567. looks like the pick threshold for "arch_preference" was too high, causing the cheaper-but-slower kernel to be chosen for mid-long sequences.

sam (perf): quick repro on my dev node reproduces p50 drop. I'll push a patch to lower arch score weight and add a guard: if seqlen >= 512 prefer seq-aware kernel unless throughput advantage > 20%. small PR incoming.

lena (infra): can we also add a smoke criterion in CI to assert no >8% regression at p50 for promoted kernels? Otherwise nightly noise slips through.

ryan (eng): agree. add a lightweight microprobe that runs only the candidate kernel at seqlen 1024 with 30 runs and checks median. should be cheap.

mina (runtime): @sam thanks — when you open PR tag it with `perf:autotune` and `ci:smoke`. I'll add an eval set to Optimize that checks generated outputs vs baseline (quality guard).

ci-bot: PR 4821 created by sam (perf) — title: "tune: lower arch weight in selective-autotune; add seqlen>=512 guard". Link: https://git.internal/pulls/4821

sam (perf): PR includes a unit test for the heuristics and the harness hook. Runs locally: before: median=10.2ms, after: median=9.0ms (11.8% improvement).

mina (runtime): ok let's let the nightly sweep pick it up in a canary today, if green we'll merge and backfill. marking this thread 'follow-up: perf' :thumbsup:

ryan (eng): leaving a note to add a short doc blurb about "selective-autotune" rules in docs/internal/kernelexplainer.md — it helps oncall triage next time.

perf-ci-bot: scheduled canary run for PR 4821 on ampere-rt at 2471238000.

mina (runtime): thanks all. I'll follow up with the KV cache profile later — suspecting the cache pressure changed a bit when kernel path switch altered memory stride.
